tests.title: Settings → Email: empty-state renders for admin
steps: Open the web app at http://localhost:3021
Sign in as franchisee@gmail.com (admin of Test Fitness Franchise)
Navigate to /dashboard/settings/email via the sidebar Settings → Email link
Confirm the Email page renders with the PageHeader 'Email'
Confirm the Sending domains card shows the empty-state message 'No sending domains yet'
Confirm the Add a sending domain card renders with Domain, From name, and Default local-part inputs

tests.title: Settings → Email: domain row renders with sender, status, and DNS records
steps: Submit the Add a sending domain form (real API hit — Resend's sandbox API key correctly refuses domain creation with 'API key restricted to send-only')
Seed a representative email_domains row directly (status=pending, fromName='E2E Seed Sender', defaultLocalPart='noreply', mock DNS records snapshot)
Reload /dashboard/settings/email
Confirm the seeded row appears in the Sending domains table
Confirm the Sender cell shows the row's fromName + 'noreply@<domain>' preview
Confirm the status badge reads 'pending' and Verified at column shows '—'
Click DNS records to expand the row
Confirm the inline DNS table renders TXT (_resend), TXT (DKIM), MX (priority 10), and TXT (_dmarc) entries with verbatim values from the snapshot

tests.title: Settings → Email: edit sender + delete domain
steps: With the seeded domain row visible, click Edit sender
Edit dialog opens preloaded with fromName='E2E Seed Sender' and localPart='noreply'
Change fromName to 'E2E Renamed Sender' and localPart to 'billing'
Confirm the live preview reads 'Will send as: E2E Renamed Sender <billing@mail-e2e-seed.example.com>'
Click Save and wait for the toast 'Sender settings saved.'
Confirm the row now shows 'E2E Renamed Sender' and 'billing@mail-e2e-seed.example.com'
Click Delete; the DeleteConfirmDialog opens asking 'Are you sure you want to delete the sending domain mail-e2e-seed.example.com?'

Confirm Delete; the Resend.domains.remove call surfaces an error toast for the synthetic resend_domain_id ('Failed to delete domain at Resend; please retry.') — the row remains in DB, which is the documented error-path behavior
Clean up via direct DB DELETE and reload
Confirm the Sending domains card returns to empty state ('No sending domains yet')
